title: Providing Roofing sheet & construction of base for NAIS Antenna at Deep Bhavan, Kochi
summary: E-tender for providing roofing sheets and constructing a base for the National AIS (NAIS) antenna at the Deep Bhavan office building of the Cochin Directorate, Kadavanthra, Kochi.

procurement.issuing_office: Directorate of Lighthouses and Lightships, Cochin

sites.name: Deep Bhavan, Gandhinagar, Kadavanthra P.O. Cochin 682 020
sites.work: Roofing sheet and construction of base for NAIS antenna

scope.item: Providing Roofing sheet & construction of base for NAIS Antenna

money.notes: Tender fee Nil. EMD by DD/FDR from any scheduled bank in favour of Director of Lighthouses and Lightships - Cochin, payable at Ernakulam; originals (or MSME/UDYAM/NSIC certificate) with technical documents to reach office by 22.04.2025 1500 hrs. Bid Securing Declaration also listed.

period.bid_validity: 90 days from date of opening of technical bid

eligibility: Valid registration in appropriate category and class with CPWD/State PWD/Railways/MES/BSNL or other State/Central Govt/PSU/autonomous body
Similar works completed in last 7 years: three works each >= 40% of estimated cost, or two each >= 50%, or one >= 80%

Similar works: roof sheet truss work of multistorey building, solar frame truss work, waterproofing, construction of residential/institutional/office buildings/lighthouse tower or related civil construction
Annual turnover of last three years certified by Chartered Accountant
Declaration that bid is unconditional; affidavit on Rs 100 stamp paper that bidder is not blacklisted
Undertaking listing relatives serving as Gazetted/Account officers in MoPSW or DGLL
Copy of EPF / labour registration certificate; Tender Acceptance Letter; Bid Securing Declaration
notes: Section I (NIT) only; no BOQ. Bid download/submission 03.04.2025 10:00 to 23.04.2025 15:00; bid query last date 08.04.2025 15:00. Site is the directorate office, not a lighthouse station.
